text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I'm not good enough... I can't win as I am right now...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I want to win the Kikuka Sho, I have to
grow
strong enough to remain
unaffected by whatever
troubles come
my way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond trains daily in
preparation for
the Kikuka Sho. Day by
day, I can tell her
performance is
becoming sharper and more
polished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although there are no problems with her

progress, Satono Diamond seems to be
pushing
herself extremely hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In particular, I keep hearing her
repeating the
phrase "I need the
strength to overcome the jinx!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Whew!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm able to handle incline dashes
pretty
easily now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll try running one more for now!
choice_data_list: Think you can handle two more reps?
Think you can handle two more reps?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if her near obsession with the
jinx is due
to the weight of the Satono
family's expectations
on her shoulders. If
so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think I would benefit from asking for
help from a
very particular someone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best today, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
M-M-McQueen?! You're training with
me today?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think so too! Thank you so much
for this
precious opportunity, McQueen!
choice_data_list: There's a lot you can learn, wouldn't you say?
There's a lot you can learn, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. No need to thank me. This will be
a good
experience for me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Since we don't have a lot of time, let's
warm up
with a light run, then do some
partner running.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sounds good!

text_block_list.name: Dia & McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaaah!
Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I was so close to catching you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You fell too far behind in the first half.
You
should focus on reworking your
strategy to keep
up with the leading
runner's pace.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense... Thank you! This has
really
helped me identify my
shortcomings!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that. Now then,
how about
we cool down with a jog?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond wears a bright, cheerful

expression on her face, and the
desperation that
previously plagued her
is nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems I was right in choosing to talk
with Mejiro
McQueen. I figured she'd
understand Satono
Diamond's situation,
being in a similar one
herself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Oh! Um, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I just saw a food truck that's selling
honeyade!
Would it be all right if I go
buy one?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you're right. Why don't we go
ahead and
take a refreshment break?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a large beverage you've
ordered
there...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. This food truck actually has a
famous jinx
associated with it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Supposedly, if you drink an XL lemon
honeyade
with extra whipped, thick
honey, you'll lose your
next race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd drink one before the
Kikuka Sho in
order to break the jinx!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Break the... jinx?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, the reason why I
ran in the
Satsuki Sho and Japanese
Derby is because of a
jinx...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why you're more
determined than
ever to overcome the
jinx in the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I refuse to lose to it! The Kikuka
Sho will
serve as my proof that I can
beat it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your resolve to grow stronger and
overcome your
jinx is truly admirable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Is it possible that your perceiving bad
luck as a
jinx is the very reason you lost
your composure?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to racing, especially in
the longer
races, maintaining one's calm
is paramount for
victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Discomposure leads to inattentiveness,
and the
mental strain can drain your
stamina. As a result,
you become unable
to run in the manner you
want.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I had a similar experience. I was struck
by some
bad luck during a crucial race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You've gone through the same thing
too? Oh...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Was that during the spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was a critical race for me, as I was
aiming
for consecutive victories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But just before I entered the starting
gate, I felt
my right foot snag on
something, and discovered
one of my
cleats had come clear off.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I remember. It was bent in half, so you
repaired it
right then and there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's right. At the time, I didn't think of
the
damaged cleat as being bad luck.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I just calmly focused on fixing it. And so,
when
the race began...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The thing I thought about and paid
attention to
wasn't my right cleat or
even Teio, whom people
regarded as my
rival then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I only gave mind to running well and
winning the
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I focused on my own running for the
whole 3,200
meters. That's the reason I
managed to win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Focus only on your own running...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
During the Japanese Derby, my cleat
got
damaged and I had to wear my spare
shoes. They
were all I could think about
for the entire race...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't concentrate on the race at all.
It was
frustrating not being able to run
the way I
wanted...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. It seems you've finally realized it
for
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You mean my preoccupation with the
jinx is
what's keeping me prisoner to it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I stop thinking about it, then it won't
affect
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is what I think, at least.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've never considered that before. But
that does
make sense...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I think I understand why you're able to
carry
yourself with such unfaltering
strength.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're able to conduct yourself with
grace and
dignity because you're always
focusing solely on
your own running and
goals.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you're very grounded.
Hehe! You
really are incredible,
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am humbled by your praise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You know, jinxes are generally created
after
something bad has happened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I had lost that race, people might have
said it
was because of a jinx. But when I
won, there was
no mention of any such
thing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's true, now that you mention it!
Then the jinx
that says you'll lose your
next race if you drink a
lemon honeyade
might be the same...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it arose from its tendency to
offset
people's weights. It's quite
calorically dense, and
the lemon flavor
masks its sugar content.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh... I already finished mine...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! I need to do some extra
training to
work off the honeyade!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I wrote down the challenges I
need to
overcome before the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to work on my pacing for the

3,000-meter race, research race
positioning,
simulate race scenarios...
and I have to build more
endurance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There are so many things I need to
address! I
don't have any time to worry
about jinxes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to perfect my running and
seize certain
victory in the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond makes a powerful
declaration
for victory with a bright
expression on her face!
